text: SPCX closed $156.54 (-4.2%), TSLA $375.23 (-0.7%). Roadster stream confirmed Thu Oct 15 7:55pm CT.
Analyst commentary (Gary Black) frames merger buzz as near-term TSLA driver; no company confirmation.
Tesla 8-K: Q3 deliveries 486,532; Q3 earnings set for Oct 21 after close. Not a merger filing.
Original Roadster date; postponed to Oct 15 (weather/high winds). No 8-K.
Tesla 8-K: $30B senior unsecured facilities ($20B delayed-draw term loan, $8B 5-yr revolver, $2B 364-day); no plan to draw in 2026.
Electrek: Tesla wins SEC OK to auto-vote retail shares with the board; still no 2026 AGM date or proxy.
Starship Flight 14: first orbital flight, 26 Starlink V3 deployed, shortened after engine-outs, controlled splashdown. Roadster delay announced same day.
Tesla Semi factory inauguration (Sparks, NV), customers announced; same day SPCX unlock #6.
End of Grok thread: Grok had ~35% merger 8-K by Oct 9 (Oct 2 #1, Oct 5 #2). Did not happen.
